name: Oc nui
summary: Ốc núi đá are the limestone snails the 15 February 2023 culture page says live in rock crevices and eat forest leaves. It says the meat is thick from April through August.
origin: The Ninh Bình limestone. A village was not named.
howToEat: Eat them in that season. Sở Văn hóa và Thể thao does not print a recipe beyond the season.
where: The limestone, April through August, as Sở Văn hóa và Thể thao prints it. Check on arrival for a shop.
seoDescription: Limestone snails in Ninh Bình, thick from April through August on the 15 February 2023 page.
